item.body:
### Summary

As a member, I want forum links from Safari, Messages or the clipboard to open in the app, so that I read them where I am logged in.

### Scope

`applinks:forum.hardware.fr` added next to `webcredentials`, `onOpenURL` → LOT-095 (#187) route, paste-link action (UIPasteControl).

- Module: App · Difficulty: medium · Priority: high · post-MVP
- Implements: FEAT-020 (#164)
- Absorbs: FEAT-020; user feedback open forum links in the app (≈13)
- Legacy sources (read-only, `origin/master`): `HFRswift/HFRswift.entitlements` (`webcredentials:forum.hardware.fr`, kept)
- Spec: `docs/features/FEAT-020.md` (feature spec, ADR 0011 §2; write it first if absent, crediting Bybifok) plus a short `docs/lots/LOT-138-*.md` pointing to it

### Depends on

- LOT-095 (#187, done)
- LOT-137 (#227, done)

### On hold

Held by the M5_OPEN decision: M5 opens after the M4 parity is validated, and the orchestrator opens it (operator decisions of 2026-11-02 on #379). ([decision](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379#issuecomment-6573879240))

### Feature umbrella

- Implements FEAT-020 (#164), proposed by Bybifok (credit in the spec, PR and CREDITS.md). Other lots of this feature: LOT-095 (#187); **this lot is the last one: its PR also says `Closes #164`**.

FEAT issues (#145–#165) are umbrellas and are never claimed: claim this lot's issue; the PR says `Closes #<this issue>` and `Refs #<FEAT issue>`.

### Model

Sonnet → Opus (AGENTS.md §6: the reviewer is never the author model)

### Captures needed

- #127

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Verified on a device once the AASA is captured (#127); result and AASA content on the PR.
- [ ] View logic lives in `@Observable @MainActor` models tested with Swift Testing in `App/SwiftHFRTests/`; each new test is shown to fail without the change.
- [ ] `xcodebuild build test` green on the iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0), and the `App build + tests` CI job green.
- [ ] UI strings in French; light, dark and Dynamic Type XL checked; no new dependency; no HFR fact without a source (legacy file:line or fixture).

### Before you start (agents and humans)

Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/agents/REVIEW-ROUNDS.md, docs/agents/LESSONS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, App/README.md, ADR 0012, the spec of every dependency (docs/lots/), docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md for any forum fact, docs/FIXTURES.md if captures are involved. Claim with `/claim <session-id>` on this issue before writing code; PR body `Closes #<this issue>` + `Claim: <session-id>`; never guess HFR behaviour (stop and list the captures needed).
